title: The Common Doorway: A Cross-Field Method for Generative Collapse
object_of_study: a prose-first route for comparing claims across heterogeneous vocabularies
main_question: How can structurally related claims from different fields be made mutually legible without requiring the fields to collapse into one vocabulary?
